pages.text: Run too far, climb too much or walk on hot stone, and your pads will grow sore. A cat with sore pads cannot leap or climb well.
pages.title: Sore Pads

pages.text: A dock poultice soothes sore pads and small scratches. You can also use it to heal a hurt Clan cat.
pages.title: Dock Poultice

pages.text: Yarrow tastes dreadful, but chewed into a poultice it heals sore pads too.
pages.title: Yarrow Poultice

pages.text: A long fall can break a leg. Broken bones do not heal by themselves. Hold the leg steady with a $(l)Leg Wrap$(), then a $(l)comfrey poultice$() helps the bone mend faster. Every Clan should keep comfrey!
pages.title: Broken Legs
